counterpart.name: {assistant}
dialog: Good luck out there, {player}! I should get back to the lab.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Camper Anthony: My Chimchar's flame keeps our camp warm at night. It'll warm you up too!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Camper Anthony: Burnt out! Chimchar and I will stick to boiling the kettle.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Picnicker Lauren: Pachirisu ate half our picnic, so it's bursting with energy. Watch out!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Picnicker Lauren: All that energy, and it still lost. I think it's ready for a nap now.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Youngster Austin: I've been training up and down this road all week. Time to see if it worked!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Youngster Austin: A whole week, and that's all it got me? Back to the start of the road, then.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Hiker Justin: Mt. Coronet's just ahead. I always warm up with a battle before the climb!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Hiker Justin: Warmed up? I'm worn out! I'll take the mountain slowly today.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Hiker Kevin: Rocks, rocks and more rocks! I bring my whole collection wherever I go!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Hiker Kevin: My rucksack feels heavier after a loss. Must be all those Geodude.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Battle Girl Helen: I run this road morning and night to strengthen my legs. Let's see if my Pokémon are as strong!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Battle Girl Helen: My legs are ready, but my Pokémon aren't. Back to training, all of us!

signs.trainer_tips_signpost:
Trainer Tips
A move of the same type as the Pokémon using it hits harder. Teach your Pokémon moves of their own types!
